# polar_checkout_link (Resource)

Manages a Polar checkout link. Checkout links provide a shareable URL that customers can use to purchase products.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product_ids` (Set of String) Set of product IDs available at checkout. At least one product is required.

### Optional

- `allow_discount_codes` (Boolean) Whether to allow the customer to apply discount codes. Defaults to `true`.
- `discount_id` (String) ID of a discount to pre-apply to the checkout. Once set, cannot be cleared without recreating the resource.
- `label` (String) Optional internal label to distinguish links. Once set, cannot be cleared without recreating the resource.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key-value metadata.
- `require_billing_address` (Boolean) Whether to require the customer to fill their full billing address. US customers are always required regardless. Defaults to `false`.
- `return_url` (String) When set, a back button will be shown in the checkout to return to this URL. Once set, cannot be cleared without recreating the resource.
- `success_url` (String) URL where the customer is redirected after a successful payment. You can add `checkout_id={CHECKOUT_ID}` as a query parameter. Once set, cannot be cleared without recreating the resource.
- `trial_interval` (String) The interval unit for the trial period. Must be `day`, `week`, `month`, or `year`.
- `trial_interval_count` (Number) The number of interval units for the trial period.

### Read-Only

- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret used to access the checkout link.
- `id` (String) The checkout link ID.
- `payment_processor` (String) The payment processor used. Always `stripe`.
- `url` (String) The shareable checkout URL.
